value.name: holt arrives with constables
value.description: Holt enters the cartographer's workshop accompanied by two constables, where Felix and Sable are already present.
evidence: Holt arrives with two constables. Felix and Sable are already there.

value.name: holt inspects workshop ceiling
value.description: Holt examines the room and notices the low plastered ceiling, a detail that informs his reassessment of the crime scene.
evidence: Holt steps inside and examines the room. He looks up at the low, plastered ceiling -- smooth and close overhead, nothing like the raftered space of a tradesman's hall.

value.name: holt arrests sable
value.description: Holt formally places Sable under arrest for suspicion of stealing the Northern Reaches map.
evidence:
HOLT
Miss Cross. I am placing you under arrest on suspicion of the theft of the Northern Reaches map.

value.name: holt cites new evidence
value.description: When Sable protests that she was previously cleared, Holt says new evidence has emerged and leaves judgment to the magistrate.
evidence:
SABLE
You cleared me. My alibi -- three witnesses --

HOLT
New evidence has come to light. If you are innocent, the magistrate will say so.

value.name: felix defends sable
value.description: Felix challenges Holt's reversal and insists that Holt himself had accepted Sable's market alibi.
evidence:
FELIX
(stepping forward)
This is wrong. You declared her cleared yourself. You said three witnesses placed her at the market all morning.

value.name: constables seize sable
value.description: After Holt orders Felix back, the constables take Sable by the arms and she submits without resisting.
evidence: The constables take Sable by the arms. She does not struggle.

value.name: sable shares hollow look
value.description: As she is detained, Sable looks at Felix with a hollow expression, underscoring her emotional state and their connection.
evidence: She looks at Felix, her expression hollow.

value.name: holt revises entry theory
value.description: Holt announces that he has reconsidered the break-in and now believes the thief entered through the front door rather than the window.
evidence: Holt turns and studies the room.

HOLT (CONT'D)
I have been reconsidering the entry point. The window latch, though worn, shows no sign of recent movement. I now believe the thief entered through the FRONT DOOR. Someone had access.

value.name: felix produces chest key
value.description: Felix responds by asserting the door was locked and reveals the iron key he says is the only key to the chest.
evidence:
FELIX
The door was locked. This is the only key to the chest.
He reaches into his COAT POCKET and produces the iron key.

value.name: holt questions key claim
value.description: Holt rejects Felix's assertion about the key, signaling continued suspicion about access to the workshop or chest.
evidence:
HOLT
We will see about that.

value.name: sable is led away
value.description: The constables remove Sable from the workshop, leaving Felix alone holding the key.
evidence: Sable is led away. Felix stands alone in the moonlit workshop, the key in his hand.
